shared_elements: human face with eyes, nose and mouth
justification: Both depict human faces rendered frontally in a schematic, non-naturalistic manner, but that is essentially all they share. A shows only an isolated, plain head with minimal incised features and no attributes, while B shows a complex symmetrical composition of two profile-faced, elaborately costumed figures flanking a central axial figure/staff with a large rayed disc, headdresses, ear ornaments and held objects — none of which appears in A.
